notes.title: Update 1.1 Stereoscopic images and hidden galleries.
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.1 Is live[/b]

- Virtual Gallery now supports stereoscopic images. Take a look at the new demo gallery with stereoscopic images made by Andrew Brooks.

- Sometimes you just want to hide some galleries from the rest of the world, You can give a gallery a password, and it will only be shown after the password is set.

notes.title: Changes 2-2-2021
notes.content:
- Shifted around continuous movement controls: Left controller move and strafe, right controller rotation.
- A number of changes to the graphics settings to hopefully take away the image flickering some users were experiencing. If the images still flicker please let me know, there are some other tricks i can try out.
